Executive Overview
The Hub connects project updates with TPMO reporting and oversight
Project teams
Maintain workplans, progress and project registers. Prepare weekly reports using the same source data.
TPMO
Review project and program performance. Compare status trends and focus discussion on milestones or items needing action.
Expected value: less repeated reporting and clearer visibility of project performance

Business Background
BPI’s requirements place TPMO at the center of project oversight
Project level
Teams maintain task ownership, schedules, progress and project events.
Program level
Related sub-initiatives contribute to a consolidated schedule and program KPIs.
Portfolio level
TPMO compares project health, milestones and quarterly release commitments.
Requirements baseline
36 functional requirements marked essential, P1 and in scope for the POC.

Current Challenges

Schedule consolidation
Separate workplans make project and program dependencies harder to review.
Baseline traceability

Weekly reporting
Repeated data entry can slow reporting and create inconsistent figures.
Management attention
Aging risks, issues and delayed commitments need consistent visibility.

Tasks, dependencies, critical path, baselines, earned value and program roll-up.
Project Binder

Weekly reporting

Portfolio and admin
Dashboards, project profiles, templates, report definitions and standard exports.

Plan and compare

Monitor exceptions

Review the portfolio

Project review
Check overdue activities, milestones and issues; find missing owners, dates and risk mitigations.
Portfolio briefing
Summarize visible projects and highlight recorded health factors and follow-up needs.
PSR drafting
Prepare accomplishments, next-period plans and issues for the current reporting month.
Guidance and lookup
Explain app steps and look up assigned work, ownership, progress and reporting deadlines.

title: AVA Entry Points and User Control

text: AVA Entry Points and User Control
Page buttons open AVA chat; changes require a separate user action
Project header
Ask AVA opens a contextual conversation about project health.
PSR editor
Draft with AVA requests a narrative for the editable status report.
Review and apply
An authorized PM reviews the proposal and clicks Apply. Submission and approval stay separate.
Basic commands
Built-in assignment and progress commands prepare proposals for the user to Apply or Dismiss.
Available actions follow the user’s role and project access. Suggestions must be enabled to apply changes.

AVA Availability and Rollout
Local implementation is distinct from a connected, accepted AI service
Implemented
Custom Agent integration, grounded review checks, PSR proposals and app-side access guards.
Live AI setup
Publish AVA, configure its Agent ID and validate responses against actual project records.
Acceptance checks
Verify role access, source links, PSR Apply, changed-data rejection and failed-run recovery.
Outside active scope
What-if tools, S-curve analysis and broader record actions are not connected to the current agent path.
Confirm the published agent and complete live acceptance before presenting AI mode as operational.

End-to-End Process
A representative weekly operating cycle
Set up
Create the profile, workplan, owners and baseline.
Maintain
Update progress, actual dates and Binder actions.
Report
Review pulled figures and complete weekly highlights.
Review
Export the report and inspect portfolio exceptions.
Act
Assign follow-up actions and update the next cycle.
